verses.textZh: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各的兄弟犹大，写信给那些被召的人，就是在父神里蒙爱，并且为了耶稣基督而蒙保守的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各的兄弟犹大，写信给那些被召的人，就是在父神里蒙爱，并且为了耶稣基督而蒙保守的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各的弟兄犹大，写信给那被召、在父神里蒙爱、为耶稣基督保守的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnEsv: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, To those who are called, beloved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNkjv: Jude, a bondservant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, To those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ and a brother of James. I am writing to all who have been called by God the Father, who loves you and keeps you safe in the care of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Jude, a bond-servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, To those who are the called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.textEn: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:

verses.textZh: 愿怜悯、平安、慈爱多多加给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿怜悯、平安、慈爱多多加给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿怜恤、平安、慈爱多多地加给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNlt: May God give you more and more mercy, peace, and love.
verses.textEnNasb: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
verses.textEn: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，尽管我曾经迫切地想写信给你们，论到我们共享的救恩；现在我更觉得必须写信劝勉你们，要竭力维护从前一次就全交给了圣徒的信仰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，尽管我曾经迫切地想写信给你们，论到我们共享的救恩；现在我更觉得必须写信劝勉你们，要竭力维护从前一次就全交给了圣徒的信仰，
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我想尽心写信给你们，论我们同得救恩的时候，就不得不写信劝你们，要为从前一次交付圣徒的真道竭力地争辩。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt compelled to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to God’s holy people.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, although I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I found it necessary to write appealing to you to contend for the faith that was once for all delivered to the saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, while I was very diligent to write to you concerning our common salvation, I found it necessary to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, I had been eagerly planning to write to you about the salvation we all share. But now I find that I must write about something else, urging you to defend the faith that God has entrusted once for all time to his holy people.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, while I was making every effort to write you about our common salvation, I felt the necessity to write to you appealing that you contend earnestly for the faith that was once for all time handed down to the saints.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt compelled to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to God’s holy people.

verses.textZh: 因为有人已经混进你们中间，他们就是早被判定受刑的不敬虔的人。这些人把我们神的恩典当作放纵情欲的借口，并且否认独一的主宰我们的主耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有人已经混进你们中间，他们就是早被判定受刑的不敬虔的人。这些人把我们神的恩典当作放纵情欲的借口，并且否认独一的主宰我们的主耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有些人偷着进来，就是自古被定受刑罚的，是不虔诚的，将我们神的恩变作放纵情欲的机会，并且不认独一的主宰－我们 主耶稣基督。
verses.textEnNiv: For certain individuals whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are ungodly people, who pervert the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: For certain people have crept in unnoticed who long ago were designated for this condemnation, ungodly people, who pervert the grace of our God into sensuality and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For certain men have crept in unnoticed, who long ago were marked out for this condemnation, ungodly men, who turn the grace of our God into lewdness and deny the only Lord God and our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I say this because some ungodly people have wormed their way into your churches, saying that God’s marvelous grace allows us to live immoral lives. The condemnation of such people was recorded long ago, for they have denied our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For certain people have crept in unnoticed, those who were long beforehand marked out for this condemnation, ungodly persons who turn the grace of our God into indecent behavior and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: For certain individuals whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are ungodly people, who pervert the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.

verses.textZh: 虽然这一切事情你们都早已知道，我仍然要提醒你们：从前主从埃及地把人民救出来，跟着就把那些不信的人除灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这一切事情你们都早已知道，我仍然要提醒你们：从前主从埃及地把人民救出来，跟着就把那些不信的人除灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前主救了他的百姓出埃及地，后来就把那些不信的灭绝了。这一切的事，你们虽然都知道，我却仍要提醒你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord at one time delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I want to remind you, although you once fully knew it, that Jesus, who saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I want to remind you, though you once knew this, that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
verses.textEnNlt: So I want to remind you, though you already know these things, that Jesus first rescued the nation of Israel from Egypt, but later he destroyed those who did not remain faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I want to remind you, though you know everything once and for all, that the Lord, after saving a people out of the land of Egypt, subsequently destroyed those who did not believe.
verses.textEn: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord at one time delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.

verses.textZh: 还有，那不守本位擅离自己居所的天使，主就用永远的锁炼把他们拘留在黑暗里，直到那大日子的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，那不守本位擅离自己居所的天使，主就用永远的锁炼把他们拘留在黑暗里，直到那大日子的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有不守本位、离开自己住处的天使，主用锁链把他们永远拘留在黑暗里，等候大日的审判。
verses.textEnNiv: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their proper dwelling—these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angels who did not stay within their own position of authority, but left their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal chains under gloomy darkness until the judgment of the great day—
verses.textEnNkjv: And the angels who did not keep their proper domain, but left their own abode, He has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness for the judgment of the great day;
verses.textEnNlt: And I remind you of the angels who did not stay within the limits of authority God gave them but left the place where they belonged. God has kept them securely chained in prisons of darkness, waiting for the great day of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: And angels who did not keep their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling place, these He has kept in eternal restraints under darkness for the judgment of the great day,
verses.textEn: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their proper dwelling—these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.

verses.textZh: 又像所多玛、蛾摩拉和周围城市的人，与他们一样的淫乱，随从逆性的情欲，以致遭受永火的刑罚，成了后世的鉴戒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又像所多玛、蛾摩拉和周围城市的人，与他们一样的淫乱，随从逆性的情欲，以致遭受永火的刑罚，成了后世的鉴戒。
verses.textZhCuv: 又如所多玛、蛾摩拉和周围城邑的人，也照他们一味地行淫，随从逆性的情欲，就受永火的刑罚，作为鉴戒。
verses.textEnNiv: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.textEnEsv: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which likewise indulged in sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desire, serve as an example by undergoing a punishment of eternal fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them in a similar manner to these, having given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t forget Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring towns, which were filled with immorality and every kind of sexual perversion. Those cities were destroyed by fire and serve as a warning of the eternal fire of God’s judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, since they in the same way as these angels indulged in sexual perversion and went after strange flesh, are exhibited as an example in undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.textEn: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.

verses.textZh: 虽然是这样，这些醉生梦死的人还是照样玷污身体，藐视主权，毁谤尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然是这样，这些醉生梦死的人还是照样玷污身体，藐视主权，毁谤尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些做梦的人也像他们污秽身体，轻慢主治的，毁谤在尊位的。
verses.textEnNiv: In the very same way, on the strength of their dreams these ungodly people pollute their own bodies, reject authority and heap abuse on celestial beings.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet in like manner these people also, relying on their dreams, defile the flesh, reject authority, and blaspheme the glorious ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise also these dreamers defile the flesh, reject authority, and speak evil of dignitaries.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, these people—who claim authority from their dreams—live immoral lives, defy authority, and scoff at supernatural beings.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet in the same way these people also, dreaming, defile the flesh, reject authority, and speak abusively of angelic majesties.
verses.textEn: In the very same way, on the strength of their dreams these ungodly people pollute their own bodies, reject authority and heap abuse on celestial beings.

verses.textZh: 就是天使长米迦勒为了摩西的尸体与魔鬼争论的时候，尚且不敢用毁谤的话定他的罪，只说："主责备你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是天使长米迦勒为了摩西的尸体与魔鬼争论的时候，尚且不敢用毁谤的话定他的罪，只说："主责备你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使长米迦勒为摩西的尸首与魔鬼争辩的时候，尚且不敢用毁谤的话罪责他，只说：「主责备你吧！」。
verses.textEnNiv: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not himself dare to condemn him for slander but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
verses.textEnEsv: But when the archangel Michael, contending with the devil, was disputing about the body of Moses, he did not presume to pronounce a blasphemous judgment, but said, "The Lord rebuke you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet Michael the archangel, in contending with the devil, when he disputed about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him a reviling accusation, but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
verses.textEnNlt: But even Michael, one of the mightiest of the angels, did not dare accuse the devil of blasphemy, but simply said, "The Lord rebuke you!" (This took place when Michael was arguing with the devil about Moses’ body.)
verses.textEnNasb: But Michael the archangel, when he disputed with the devil and argued about the body of Moses, did not dare pronounce against him an abusive judgment, but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
verses.textEn: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not himself dare to condemn him for slander but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"

verses.textZh: 但这些人毁谤他们所不知道的，他们只知道按本性所能领悟的事，好象没有理性的禽兽，就在这些事上败坏了自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这些人毁谤他们所不知道的，他们只知道按本性所能领悟的事，好象没有理性的禽兽，就在这些事上败坏了自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这些人毁谤他们所不知道的。他们本性所知道的事与那没有灵性的畜类一样，在这事上竟败坏了自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet these people slander whatever they do not understand, and the very things they do understand by instinct—as irrational animals do—will destroy them.
verses.textEnEsv: But these people blaspheme all that they do not understand, and they are destroyed by all that they, like unreasoning animals, understand instinctively.
verses.textEnNkjv: But these speak evil of whatever they do not know; and whatever they know naturally, like brute beasts, in these things they corrupt themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: But these people scoff at things they do not understand. Like unthinking animals, they do whatever their instincts tell them, and so they bring about their own destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: But these people disparage all the things that they do not understand; and all the things that they know by instinct, like unreasoning animals, by these things they are destroyed.
verses.textEn: Yet these people slander whatever they do not understand, and the very things they do understand by instinct—as irrational animals do—will destroy them.

verses.textZh: 他们有祸了，因为他们走上了该隐的道路，又为了财利闯进巴兰的歧途，并且在可拉的背叛中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有祸了，因为他们走上了该隐的道路，又为了财利闯进巴兰的歧途，并且在可拉的背叛中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们有祸了！因为走了该隐的道路，又为利往巴兰的错谬里直奔，并在可拉的背叛中灭亡了。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam’s error; they have been destroyed in Korah’s rebellion.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to them! For they walked in the way of Cain and abandoned themselves for the sake of gain to Balaam’s error and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to them! For they have gone in the way of Cain, have run greedily in the error of Balaam for profit, and perished in the rebellion of Korah.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits them! For they follow in the footsteps of Cain, who killed his brother. Like Balaam, they deceive people for money. And like Korah, they perish in their rebellion.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to them! For they have gone the way of Cain, and for pay they have given themselves up to the error of Balaam, and perished in the rebellion of Korah.
verses.textEn: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam’s error; they have been destroyed in Korah’s rebellion.

verses.textZh: 这些人胆敢与你们同席，他们只顾喂饱 自己，是你们爱筵中的暗礁；是无雨的浮云，随风飘荡；是秋天不结果子的树，连根拔起，死而又死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人胆敢与你们同席，他们只顾喂饱 自己，是你们爱筵中的暗礁；是无雨的浮云，随风飘荡；是秋天不结果子的树，连根拔起，死而又死；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的人在你们的爱席上与你们同吃的时候，正是礁石 。他们作牧人，只知喂养自己，无所惧怕；是没有雨的云彩，被风飘荡；是秋天没有果子的树，死而又死，连根被拔出来；
verses.textEnNiv: These people are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm—shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted—twice dead.
verses.textEnEsv: These are hidden reefs at your love feasts, as they feast with you without fear, shepherds feeding themselves; waterless clouds, swept along by winds; fruitless trees in late autumn, twice dead, uprooted;
verses.textEnNkjv: These are spots in your love feasts, while they feast with you without fear, serving only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried about by the winds; late autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots;
verses.textEnNlt: When these people eat with you in your fellowship meals commemorating the Lord’s love, they are like dangerous reefs that can shipwreck you. They are like shameless shepherds who care only for themselves. They are like clouds blowing over the land without giving any rain. They are like trees in autumn that are doubly dead, for they bear no fruit and have been pulled up by the roots.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who are hidden reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you without fear, like shepherds caring only for themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, doubly dead, uprooted;
verses.textEn: These people are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm—shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted—twice dead.

verses.textZh: 是海中的狂浪，溅起了自己可耻的泡沫；是流荡的星，有漆黑的幽暗永远为他们存留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是海中的狂浪，溅起了自己可耻的泡沫；是流荡的星，有漆黑的幽暗永远为他们存留。
verses.textZhCuv: 是海里的狂浪，涌出自己可耻的沫子来；是流荡的星，有墨黑的幽暗为他们永远存留。
verses.textEnNiv: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.textEnEsv: wild waves of the sea, casting up the foam of their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: raging waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars for whom is reserved the blackness of darkness forever.
verses.textEnNlt: They are like wild waves of the sea, churning up the foam of their shameful deeds. They are like wandering stars, doomed forever to blackest darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: wild waves of the sea, churning up their own shameful deeds like dirty foam; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of darkness has been reserved forever.
verses.textEn: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.

verses.textZh: 亚当的第七世孙以诺，也曾经预言这些人说："看，主必同他的千万圣者降临，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当的第七世孙以诺，也曾经预言这些人说："看，主必同他的千万圣者降临，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当的七世孙以诺曾预言这些人说：「看哪，主带着他的千万圣者降临，
verses.textEnNiv: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them: "See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones
verses.textEnEsv: It was also about these that Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, "Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of his holy ones,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about these men also, saying, "Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of His saints,
verses.textEnNlt: Enoch, who lived in the seventh generation after Adam, prophesied about these people. He said, "Listen! The Lord is coming with countless thousands of his holy ones
verses.textEnNasb: It was also about these people that Enoch, in the seventh generation from Adam, prophesied, saying, "Behold, the Lord has come with many thousands of His holy ones,
verses.textEn: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them: "See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones

verses.textZh: 要审判众人，又要定所有不敬虔的人的罪，因为他们妄行各样不敬虔的事，并且说了种种刚愎的话顶撞神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要审判众人，又要定所有不敬虔的人的罪，因为他们妄行各样不敬虔的事，并且说了种种刚愎的话顶撞神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要在众人身上行审判，证实那一切不敬虔的人所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又证实不敬虔之罪人所说顶撞他的刚愎话。」
verses.textEnNiv: to judge everyone, and to convict all of them of all the ungodly acts they have committed in their ungodliness, and of all the defiant words ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
verses.textEnEsv: to execute judgment on all and to convict all the ungodly of all their deeds of ungodliness that they have committed in such an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
verses.textEnNkjv: to execute judgment on all, to convict all who are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have committed in an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him."
verses.textEnNlt: to execute judgment on the people of the world. He will convict every person of all the ungodly things they have done and for all the insults that ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
verses.textEnNasb: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their ungodly deeds which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him."
verses.textEn: to judge everyone, and to convict all of them of all the ungodly acts they have committed in their ungodliness, and of all the defiant words ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

verses.textZh: 这些人常发牢骚，怨天尤人，顺着自己的私欲行事，口说夸张的话，为了利益就不惜阿谀奉承。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人常发牢骚，怨天尤人，顺着自己的私欲行事，口说夸张的话，为了利益就不惜阿谀奉承。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人是私下议论，常发怨言的，随从自己的情欲而行，口中说夸大的话，为得便宜谄媚人。
verses.textEnNiv: These people are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.
verses.textEnEsv: These are grumblers, malcontents, following their own sinful desires; they are loud-mouthed boasters, showing favoritism to gain advantage.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are grumblers, complainers, walking according to their own lusts; and they mouth great swelling words, flattering people to gain advantage.
verses.textEnNlt: These people are grumblers and complainers, living only to satisfy their desires. They brag loudly about themselves, and they flatter others to get what they want.
verses.textEnNasb: These are grumblers, finding fault, following after their own lusts; they speak arrogantly, flattering people for the sake of gaining an advantage.
verses.textEn: These people are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.

verses.textZh: 但你们呢，亲爱的，你们要记住我们主耶稣基督的使徒从前所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们呢，亲爱的，你们要记住我们主耶稣基督的使徒从前所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们要记念我们主耶稣基督之使徒从前所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.
verses.textEnEsv: But you must remember, beloved, the predictions of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, beloved, remember the words which were spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNlt: But you, my dear friends, must remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ predicted.
verses.textEnNasb: But you, beloved, ought to remember the words that were spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.

verses.textZh: 他们曾经对你们说："末世必有好讥笑人的人，随着自己不敬虔的私欲行事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们曾经对你们说："末世必有好讥笑人的人，随着自己不敬虔的私欲行事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们曾对你们说过，末世必有好讥诮的人随从自己不敬虔的私欲而行。
verses.textEnNiv: They said to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to you, "In the last time there will be scoffers, following their own ungodly passions."
verses.textEnNkjv: how they told you that there would be mockers in the last time who would walk according to their own ungodly lusts.
verses.textEnNlt: They told you that in the last times there would be scoffers whose purpose in life is to satisfy their ungodly desires.
verses.textEnNasb: that they were saying to you, "In the last time there will be mockers, following after their own ungodly lusts."
verses.textEn: They said to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires."

verses.textZh: 这些人分党结派，是属血气的，没有圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人分党结派，是属血气的，没有圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是那些引人结党、属乎血气、没有圣灵的人。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the people who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: It is these who cause divisions, worldly people, devoid of the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are sensual persons, who cause divisions, not having the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: These people are the ones who are creating divisions among you. They follow their natural instincts because they do not have God’s Spirit in them.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who cause divisions, worldly-minded, devoid of the Spirit.
verses.textEn: These are the people who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 但你们呢，亲爱的，你们要在至圣的信仰上建立自己，在圣灵里祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们呢，亲爱的，你们要在至圣的信仰上建立自己，在圣灵里祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们却要在至圣的真道上造就自己，在圣灵里祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: But you, dear friends, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: But you, beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: But you, dear friends, must build each other up in your most holy faith, pray in the power of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNasb: But you, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: But you, dear friends, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,

verses.textZh: 要保守自己在神的爱中，仰望我们主耶稣基督的怜悯，直到永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要保守自己在神的爱中，仰望我们主耶稣基督的怜悯，直到永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 保守自己常在神的爱中，仰望我们主耶稣基督的怜悯，直到永生。
verses.textEnNiv: keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: and await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, who will bring you eternal life. In this way, you will keep yourselves safe in God’s love.
verses.textEnNasb: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking forward to the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
verses.textEn: keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.

verses.textZh: 有些人心里疑惑，你们要怜悯他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人心里疑惑，你们要怜悯他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 有些人存疑心，你们要怜悯他们；
verses.textEnNiv: Be merciful to those who doubt;
verses.textEnEsv: And have mercy on those who doubt;
verses.textEnNkjv: And on some have compassion, making a distinction;
verses.textEnNlt: And you must show mercy to those whose faith is wavering.
verses.textEnNasb: And have mercy on some, who are doubting;
verses.textEn: Be merciful to those who doubt;

verses.textZh: 有些人你们要拯救，把他们从火中抢救出来；又有些人你们要战战兢兢地怜悯他们，连染上情欲污渍的衣服也应当憎恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人你们要拯救，把他们从火中抢救出来；又有些人你们要战战兢兢地怜悯他们，连染上情欲污渍的衣服也应当憎恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些人你们要从火中抢出来，搭救他们；有些人你们要存惧怕的心怜悯他们，连那被情欲沾染的衣服也当厌恶。
verses.textEnNiv: save others by snatching them from the fire; to others show mercy, mixed with fear—hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: save others by snatching them out of the fire; to others show mercy with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: but others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire, hating even the garment defiled by the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue others by snatching them from the flames of judgment. Show mercy to still others, but do so with great caution, hating the sins that contaminate their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: save others, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the garment polluted by the flesh.
verses.textEn: save others by snatching them from the fire; to others show mercy, mixed with fear—hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.

verses.textZh: 那能保守你们不失脚、叫你们无瑕无疵、欢欢喜喜站在他荣耀之前的我们的救主－独一的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那能保守你们不失脚、叫你们无瑕无疵、欢欢喜喜站在他荣耀之前的我们的救主－独一的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 那能保守你们不失脚、叫你们无瑕无疵、欢欢喜喜站在他荣耀之前的我们的救主－独一的神，
verses.textEnNiv: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy—
verses.textEnEsv: Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling, And to present you faultless Before the presence of His glory with exceeding joy,
verses.textEnNlt: Now all glory to God, who is able to keep you from falling away and will bring you with great joy into his glorious presence without a single fault.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to Him who is able to protect you from stumbling, and to make you stand in the presence of His glory, blameless with great joy,
verses.textEn: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy—

verses.textZh: 愿荣耀、威严、能力、权柄，因我们的主耶稣基督归与他，从万古以前并现今，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿荣耀、威严、能力、权柄，因我们的主耶稣基督归与他，从万古以前并现今，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿荣耀、威严、能力、权柄，因我们的主耶稣基督归与他，从万古以前并现今，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: to the only God, our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: To God our Savior, Who alone is wise, Be glory and majesty, Dominion and power, Both now and forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: All glory to him who alone is God, our Savior through Jesus Christ our Lord. All glory, majesty, power, and authority are his before all time, and in the present, and beyond all time! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority before all time and now and forever. Amen.
verses.textEn: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.
